scope: synthetic H-11 usability and rubric-comprehension evidence only

summary: requires an authenticated rater to record four approved synthetic-session consent statements before an initial assignment is displayed
records a structured rubric-comprehension and workflow-usability debrief after the initial assignment is submitted or withdrawn
writes consent and debrief as immutable, idempotent, append-only participant.evidence.recorded events bound to the authenticated rater and initial synthetic assignment
shows private consent and debrief status in the operator workspace and visibly highlights safety stop conditions
includes participant evidence in private exports while excluding it and its free text from public-safe exports
keeps the existing synthetic-only database schema and research-ratings authorization state unchanged

defects_found_and_fixed.finding: the participant-readiness MutationObserver observed its own descendant text and attribute updates, causing a feedback loop after the new consent state re-rendered
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: observe only direct child-list replacement in the staging workspace; descendant form and status changes no longer retrigger the enhancer

defects_found_and_fixed.finding: the skip link animated from an off-screen top position and was still partly outside the viewport at the instant keyboard focus was asserted
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: remove the focus transition and support both :focus and :focus-visible so the link appears immediately

checks: ordinary public build excludes the staging shell
designated release-preview and explicit staging builds include participant-readiness assets
PostgreSQL restart, chain readback, backup, and exact second-database restore
rendered Chromium: full two-rater lifecycle plus desktop/mobile participant-readiness and keyboard-focus checks
